description: Use count-based Morgan fingerprints with radius 3 and 4096 bits (chirality off) and RF max_features 0.2.
Concatenate RDKit descriptors with count Morgan (r2, 1024 bits) and fit LightGBM (L1, lr 0.03, 1000 trees, colsample 0.3, min_child_samples 10).
Switch the LightGBM objective from L1 to huber (alpha=1.0) to compare against the L1 objective on descriptor+Morgan features.
The current train.py already concatenates all RDKit descriptors with Morgan counts (slot 1), so this idea is already in the incumbent and I'm aborting.
Train three LightGBMs on separate feature sets (RDKit descriptors, count Morgan, count atom-pairs) and average their predictions equally.
Stack RF, LightGBM, CatBoost and SVR via inner 5-fold OOF predictions with a non-negative Ridge meta-learner, using lightweight base models to fit the time limit.

Cache per-molecule features, since the same 3360 molecules are re-featurized with 210 RDKit descriptors in every one of the 15 fits. Also use 3 inner stacking folds instead of 5, so each fit trains 5 sets of models instead of 6.
